newsitem.title: USA: Telebras signs global telecom pact.
newsitem.headline: Telebras signs global telecom pact.

text.p: Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA said Friday it signed agreements to provide global telecommunications services with Concert Communications Services and WorldPartners on July 14.

Telebras also said it did not plan to change its basic service tariffs. It added it would consider rate changes only after the company's monopoly in Brazil ends and competitive factors would make a modification necessary.
Telebras and its partners will provide international services for multinational corporations' intra-company communications under the agreements, the company said.
Telebras said MCI Communications Corp and British Telecommunications Plc have stakes in Concert, while ATT, Singapore Telecommunications Ltd and 15 other companies have interests in WorldPartners.

Telebras said the agreements aim to service foreign multinational companies operating in Brazil and Brazilian companies abroad and give the company the exclusive right to offer Concert's and WorldPartners services in Brazil, including existing contracts.

It added the services will have a global scope; single point for hiring, project development, operations management and payment; end-to-end management; standardized performance with consistent quality level; and a high degree of technological integration in voice, image and data.
